notes: Statutory TDS rates and thresholds for resident individual payees furnishing PAN, for tax year 2026-27 under sections 392 and 393 of the Income-tax Act, 2025. Payments or credits made on or before 31 March 2026 (FY 2025-26) stay under Chapter XVII-B of the Income-tax Act, 1961; the old section numbers are kept as keys and shown in brackets.
assumptions: Payee is a resident individual who has furnished a valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) to the deductor.

Calculations reflect the rates and thresholds in sections 392 and 393 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 and Part II of the First Schedule to the Finance Act, 2026, for payments or credits from 1 April 2026.
Section-specific threshold limits apply on an aggregate tax-year basis per payer-payee relationship unless the Act states a single-transaction or monthly limit.
limitations: A higher rate of 20% (5% for purchase of goods and e-commerce payments) applies under section 397(2)(b) [old 206AA] if a valid PAN is not furnished by the payee.
Payments or credits on or before 31 March 2026 (FY 2025-26) are governed by the Income-tax Act, 1961.
Does not process lower or nil deduction certificates under section 395 [old 197] or self-declarations under section 393(6) [old Form 15G / 15H].
Educational calculator for compliance estimation; the deductor's TDS certificate is the statutory proof of tax deducted.
disclaimer: This calculator uses the rules/data published by the Income Tax Department for tax year 2026-27 (Income-tax Act, 2025). Estimated result based on the inputs and assumptions provided. Educational tool only; not legal or filing advice. Check official guidance for your specific situation.
